ko.executive_summary: Qualcomm launches AI-first Snapdragon chips and renews its patent licensing deal with Apple, strengthening its position in AI-enabled mobile processors.

implications.text: Snapdragon portfolio shift toward on-device AI capabilities positions Qualcomm to capture demand from OEMs deploying AI features in flagship and mid-tier smartphones.
Patent agreement renewal ensures continued revenue stream and signals sustained demand for Qualcomm IP across Apple's product roadmap.

ko.counterpoint: Limited details on Snapdragon AI specifications, performance metrics, or timeline for mass deployment.
